step4.guideSubtitle: Pick the option that best matches your daily business setup and tools:

guideItems.title: Shop Counter & UPI Billing POS
guideItems.easyDesc: For single shops, grocery stores, or cafes on mobile hotspots. Gives dedicated counter Wi-Fi so your UPI QR, soundbox, and card swipe machines never freeze or fail during billing.

guideItems.title: Office Suite, Domain Email & Phone IVR
guideItems.easyDesc: For clinics, CA firms, and consultancy offices on home internet. Gives commercial fiber broadband, professional domain emails (you@firm.com), and an automated IVR reception greeting so patient or client calls are never missed.

guideItems.title: Multi-Store Outlets, CCTV & Backup
guideItems.easyDesc: For multi-outlet businesses. Syncs live billing across stores (SD-WAN), provides 24/7 mobile-view CCTV cameras, and automatic 4G/5G backup router that kicks in instantly if fiber wire gets cut outside.

guideItems.title: 1:1 Dedicated Leased Line & Machine IoT
guideItems.easyDesc: For factories, manufacturing plants, and tech centers. Provides an unshared 1:1 dedicated leased line with 99.5% uptime SLA guarantee, static IP for servers, and real-time connectivity for factory machinery and IoT sensors.

step5.header: Discovery complete! Tailored digital bundle assembled from Airtel Product Catalogue:

rationales.clinic: Replaces unreliable home broadband with high-speed commercial fiber. Smart Cloud Telephony with automated greeting ensures patient appointment calls are never missed, while Endpoint Security protects confidential patient medical records.
rationales.restaurant: Multi-site branches are linked with Managed SD-WAN for seamless POS and kitchen order sync. Dual 4G/5G failover guarantees zero payment disruptions when primary fiber trips. Cloud CCTV enables 24/7 centralized camera surveillance across all dining locations.
rationales.kirana: Cost-effective 100 Mbps commercial fiber combined with a fixed Static IP guarantees uninterrupted UPI QR code payments and POS billing with 99.5% commercial uptime.
rationales.manufacturing: A private 1:1 fiber line reserved purely for your facility ensures your ERP, inventory systems, and automated machinery run with guaranteed 99.9% uptime. Smart IoT sensors track machine running time and power usage, while enterprise firewall security blocks cyber attacks 24/7.
rationales.office: High-speed 300 Mbps commercial fiber bundled with professional company email and antivirus security to protect confidential client files, tax filings, and audit records with 99.5% uptime.

tabQuote.heading: Customized Digital Bundle & Transparent Pricing
tabQuote.sub: Single consolidated invoice. Server-side price lock. Toggle optional add-ons in real-time.
tabQuote.addonFailoverDesc: If the main internet wire ever cuts, it instantly switches to mobile SIM data so your UPI payments and card machines never stop working.
tabQuote.addonCctvDesc: Watch live shop video and past 30 days of recordings directly on your smartphone anytime, anywhere—no expensive recording machine needed.
tabQuote.addonStaticIpDesc: A fixed, permanent internet address for your business—required for staff biometric attendance machines, local servers, and direct bank billing.
